items.title: Banking Trojans Attacking Android Users Mimic as Government and Legitimate Payment Apps
items.description: A sophisticated cybercriminal campaign has emerged targeting Indonesian and Vietnamese Android users with banking trojans disguised as legitimate government identity applications and payment services. The malicious operation, active since approximately August 2024, employs advanced evasion techniques to deliver variants of the BankBot trojan family while maintaining an extensive infrastructure…

items.title: Critical DNN Platform Vulnerability Let Attackers Execute Malicious Scripts
items.description: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability has emerged in the popular DotNetNuke (DNN) Platform, threatening websites powered by this widely-used content management system.
